pages.summary: EU AI Act Art-27 Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment template. 14 sections × 60-min completion (DEFONEOS pre-fill). Cross-walked to AI Act Art-27(a)-(f) + all 50 EU Charter articles (8 commonly affected: dignity, life, liberty, privacy, data, non-discrimination, expression, consumer, judicial) + 5 national FRAs (DE BfDI / FR CNIL / NL AP / ES AEPD / IT GPDP). BFT 33-agent council pre-clearance vote (≥23/33 quorum) parallel.

Canonical 24/7 ops playbook replacing 14 scattered legacy docs. 16 named runbooks (SRE on-call, security IR, compliance, support, BFT council, model deploy, data pipeline, AI-BOM, vuln patching, PMS, pilot lifecycle, procurement, cross-border, FRIA, status page) × 8 escalation paths × 6 incident classes (P1-Critical → P6-Drift) × 4 weekly cadence rituals (Monday health, Wednesday council, Friday security, Sunday PMS).

1-page monthly memo + 9-section QBR template. 4 KPI categories (Revenue / Pipeline / Operational / Compliance) × 2 risks × 1 ask. Cadence: weekly async + monthly sync + quarterly QBR + annual strategy offsite. Includes live CSOAI own-board July 2026 memo as worked example. SIGIL-anchored for audit trail. Used by CSOAI internally + published for buyer adoption.
